items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I get Jimmy Cheatham who was in the service, we were together. I bring him in and between the two of us man, we formed a company called Wide World of Music

ctx.x: Who wrote for that? Who arranged for that?
Oh, Cheatham, Jimmy Cheatham, there you go.

items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I hadn’t had that experience at all... So I hadn’t had a chance to meet any of the big guys like that.

ctx.x: And Lester Young and all these people, because they were in the service with him.
Yeah. Chico Hamilton and — I slept in the top bunk and Chico slept on the bottom you see?

And I hadn’t had that experience at all, because I stayed mostly up in Canada and in the middle part of the country where we played mostly. So I hadn’t had a chance to meet any of the big guys like that.
